title: Migrate 3D model state to Zustand
description: Fix state reset bugs by migrating from component-local state + Leva to centralized Zustand store. Currently when one control changes (e.g., headlight), re-renders can reset other state (especially bogie).

title: Install zustand dependency
description: Run: npm install zustand

title: Create Zustand store /src/stores/model-store.ts
description: Create central store with all 11 state properties: headlightIntensity, taillightIntensity, taillightColor, lidOpen, bogieTarget, autoRotate, fov, ambientLight, backgroundIntensity, backgroundBlur, environmentIntensity. Use subscribeWithSelector middleware. Add persist middleware for taillightColor only.

title: Create Leva sync hook /src/hooks/useLevaModelControls.ts
description: Encapsulates Leva-Zustand bidirectional sync: Leva onChange writes to store, store changes update Leva via subscription. Use isLevaChange ref to prevent feedback loops.

title: Modify E-model.tsx to use Zustand store
description: Remove local useState (headlight/taillight intensity, color). Remove callback props. Subscribe to store with selectors. Add useEffect to trigger spring animation when bogieTarget changes. Add useEffect to trigger lid animation when lidOpen changes. Keep react-spring for bogie, Three.js refs for raycasting, touchFlag in imperative handle.

title: Modify index.tsx to use Zustand store
description: Replace useModelControls with useLevaModelControls. Remove bogie workaround (lines 124-138). Simplify Model component props. Update EnvironmentWrapper to read from store. Update CameraController to read fov from store. Update OrbitControls to use autoRotate from store.

title: Test all interactions and remove debug logs
description: Test: headlight/taillight toggle via click updates Leva, sliders update model, taillight color persists after reload, lid click/checkbox works, wheel clicks animate bogie, CRITICAL: changing one control does NOT reset others. Remove console.log statements.

title: Investigate bogie reset when lid is toggled
description: User reports: adjust bogie, open lid -> bogie resets. Need to trace the data flow and find where the reset occurs.

title: Bogie animation visually resets when lid is toggled
description: When lid is toggled, the bogie animation resets to initial position visually, even though Zustand state and Leva UI show correct value. Root cause: the initialization useEffect at lines 196-215 depends on [actions] and calls rockerAction.reset() which resets animation time to 0.

title: Analyze: Verify actions ref changes on lid toggle
description: Add console.log to verify that actions reference changes when lid state changes, causing the initialization useEffect to re-run and reset rocker animation.

title: Fix: Separate animation initialization effects
description: Split the initialization useEffect into two: one for lid action (can depend on actions) and one for rocker action (should only run once on mount with empty deps, or use a ref to track initialization).

title: Fix: Sync rocker animation to store on re-render
description: Alternative approach: After rocker action initializes, sync its time to current bogieTarget from store. This ensures visual state matches Zustand state even after re-initialization.
notes: Not needed - fix in 8.2 was sufficient
